Dear [Mr Innes](/person/744),
[Miss Gaye](/person/552) wants to have her M S back that she may know what to do with it.
I believe you know [Miss Cheape](/person/289)’s address, if she is not at St Andrews, would you get a proof of Christian sent to her - I sent up two chapters, but I think I can only put one in.
[Miss Tanner](/person/1395). I think you had better send to the care of
[Mrs Sidney Lear](/person/859)
the Close Salisbury
I do not know who wrote Tokens -
I suppose I told you that the Grey Woman, in the Christmas number is by Miss Benson the [Archbishop](/person/140)’s daughter[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: ‘The Grey Woman’ is a harrowing tale signed ‘A.E.D.’, which appeared in the MP Christmas number (1889).

Two letters in the Bodleian Library to [Margaret Benson](/person/1858) suggest she was a contributor, though neither seems to refer to this story directly.
